methodology: Release binaries from original baseline f2a97fc88 and unchanged branch f3c83c08a; 5 warmups per tool; 100 randomized interleaved samples per tool for short commands, 20 for target; fresh processes; perf_counter_ns; stdout /dev/null; no concurrent builds/tests. Paired Git control. RSS maximum of 5 time -v runs per tool.
